observation: Interactive and portable consumers needed the same source-owned symbol layer and display rules.
cause: Independent consumers can drift even when solved model records remain identical.
proposed_rule: Keep physical geometry separate from nonphysical annotations. Apply owner-aware facing, project view rules, hide/isolate and normal depth occlusion. Verify enabled/disabled outputs, offline HTML and fallback, without changing geometry or revisions.
limits: No new geometry or mechanical-animation inference; project-specific axes and symbol counts are not shared rules.
